MODE_DESC: A sanctum save: start with every ability, tool and crest, and relive any foe from the Loom at will.
BANNER_LOBBY: {0}  ·  The silk gate to the right leads to the Hall of Statues
ERR_FIGHT: This memory could not be woven; cancelled (your save was not changed; see the log).
ERR_ARENA: This memory could not be woven properly (arena error); back to the Loom. The attempt is not counted and your save was not changed (see the log).
ERR_RETURN: This memory did not fully unravel. Your save file was not changed: quit to the title screen from the pause menu and load again to return to the Loom as it was before the fight (see the log).
ERR_NEED_RELOAD: The Loom ran into a problem: fights and saving are paused. Quit to the title screen from the pause menu and load again (see the log).
ERR_SAVE_BLOCKED: The Loom blocked this save (slot mismatch or a bad snapshot); your save file was not changed. Quitting to the title screen and loading again is recommended (see the log).
WAIT_SAVING: Saving in progress; wait a moment before choosing a memory.
BANNER_DEATH: The thread snapped. You wake within the Loom.
